title: Cell Labeling and Targeting with Superparamagnetic Iron Oxide Nanoparticles
protocol: Wash all glassware using concentrated hydrochloric acid followed by deionized water, then ethyl alcohol.
Allow washed glassware to dry overnight in a drying oven.
Use a Dreschel bottle to degas 500 ml of deionized H2O by gently bubbling N2 gas for 30 minutes.
Set up the magnetite synthesis apparatus within a chemical fume hood.
Place a 500 ml three-neck round-bottom flask within an isomantle heater and secure it with a clamp stand.
Install a rubber septum into one side neck of the round-bottom flask and a reflux condenser with a rubber septum into another side neck.
Run cold water through the reflux condenser continuously.
Puncture the round-bottom flask’s rubber septum with a needle connected to an N2 gas line.
Puncture the reflux condenser’s rubber septum with a needle connected to a bubbler.
Install a blade paddle into the center neck of the round-bottom flask via a paddle adapter and attach it to an overhead stirrer mounted onto a stand.
Purge the round-bottom flask with N2 gas and leave N2 gas flowing at a low but detectable rate.
Remove the reflux condenser from the round-bottom flask.
Add 1.000 g of iron(III) chloride, 0.6125 g of iron(II) chloride tetrahydrate, and 50 ml of de-gassed H2O to the round-bottom flask.
Stir at 1,000 rpm while heating to 50 °C.
Add 10 ml of 28% ammonium hydroxide solution through the rubber septum in the round-bottom flask while stirring.
Heat to 90 °C to boil off the ammonia gas while still stirring.
Remove the rubber septum and N2 gas line from the round-bottom flask.
Add 1 ml of oleic acid to the round-bottom flask while stirring.
Replace the rubber septum and N2 gas line onto the round-bottom flask.
Turn off heat and stir at 500 rpm for 2 hr.
Remove the round-bottom flask from the isomantle heater.
Decant any remaining liquid while using a strong magnet to retain the magnetite gel.
Add 40 ml of hexane into the round-bottom flask to dissolve the magnetite gel.
Use a separatory funnel with 40 ml of de-gassed H2O to remove residual H2O from the magnetite solution.
Slowly pour the magnetite solution onto the H2O within the separatory funnel and gently swirl for 5 mins.
Drain out and discard the lower aqueous fraction.
Slowly add 40 ml of de-gassed H2O to the separatory funnel such that it settles beneath the magnetite solution and gently swirl.
Drain as before.
Repeat to wash for a third time.
Transfer magnetite solution to an Erlenmeyer flask.
Add a few spatulas worth of anhydrous sodium sulfate and swirl to remove any remaining residual H2O from the magnetite solution.
Filter the magnetite solution through 1 µm filter paper in a filter funnel to remove the sodium sulfate and residual H2O.
Transfer the magnetite solution to a 50 ml evaporating flask.

Use a rotary evaporator to evaporate hexane for 2 hours under moderate rotation speed, vacuum applied, and with the evaporating flask in a 50 °C water bath and 24 °C circulating water through the condenser.
Dissolve 3.60 g of PLGA (75/25 blend) in 240 ml of ethyl acetate to create a 1.5% (m/v) solution.
Dissolve 25.00 g of Pluronic F-127 in 500 ml of degassed H2O using a magnetic stirrer to create a 5.0% (m/v) solution.
Collect the magnetite gel into six 0.040 g aliquots within weighted glass vials using a microspatula.
Add a 0.040 g aliquot of magnetite gel and 40 ml of PLGA solution to a plastic beaker.
Sonicate in an ultrasonic cleaner for 10 minutes.
Add 80 ml of Pluronic solution to the plastic beaker.
Emulsify with a laboratory mixer at the highest setting for 7 minutes.
Dilute the SPION solution in 1 L of deionized H2O.
Sonicate the diluted SPION solution for 1 hour in a chemical fume hood.
Place a strong magnet next to the SPION solution and gently stir to collect brownish SPIONs at the magnet.
Decant the aqueous solution while retaining the SPIONs in the beaker with the magnet.
Suspend the collected SPIONs in 1 L of deionized H2O.
Sonicate the SPION solution for 20 minutes.
Place a strong magnet next to the SPION solution and gently stir to collect brownish SPIONs at the magnet.
Decant the aqueous solution while retaining the SPIONs in the beaker with the magnet.
Wash the collected SPIONs three times as described.
Collect the SPIONs synthesized from each of the six magnetite gel aliquots into a single weighted glass vial as an aqueous suspension.
Freeze-dry the SPION solution overnight in a lyophilizer.
Weigh the freeze-dried SPIONs.
Store the freeze-dried SPIONs at -20°C.
Suspend an aliquot of SPIONs in PBS at a concentration of 40 mg/ml.
Sonicate the SPION solution for 30 minutes.
Add the SPION solution to cell culture medium at a concentration of 5 µl/ml.
Rock the flask gently to ensure even distribution.
Incubate the cells for 16 hours at 37°C.
Aspirate the culture medium gently.
Wash cells twice with PBS.
Collect magnetically-labeled cells.
Store unused SPION solution at 4°C.
Sonicate the stored SPION solution before each use.
